freshness-production-contract.name: freshness-production-contract
freshness-production-contract.prompt: User: "maximise the parallelism so that time to emplement can reduced." Independently resolve implementation inputs for production ClockProof/control+credential projection freshness. Focus projection.rs, control_state.rs, failover_proof.rs, reader_apply.rs and existing source interfaces. Deliver exact evidence-ingestion and runtime wiring design using existing dependencies, with proposed typed inputs, startup refusal/expiry/regression behavior, concrete insertion points and tests. Do not merely repeat 'ClockProof is test-only': identify minimum defensible production source, what its evidence must establish, how to bind evidence to deployment/backend/control source, and how unavailable evidence blocks startup. Separate code we can implement locally from clock/ACA measurements that must be acquired externally; never infer qualified clock bound from local wall time or NTP status. Do not repeat prior actuator-exclusion studies or implement broader fencing. New tenant provisioning can take time; consumption begins only after verified activation. Snapshot excludes actively edited aca.rs/tests.rs/PRD; don't critique those stale versions or run full build. Read-only repository; only write pool-assigned report. No Azure/live credential access, mutation, external dependencies, gate removal, fabricated proofs, nested agents, or unrelated work. Return a bounded executable first slice with test commands, not a general research essay.
